name: applesoft
description: Drives the Applesoft interpreter in ROM. Needs no game disk: boot any disk to the monitor, then attach.
_note: The smallest profile that does something. It shows the three pieces every profile has - a regex on what is on screen, the keys to send, and a rule that ends the run - against a machine anyone can reproduce.

rules._note: First, because the prompt is still on screen after the answer is printed and the rule below would otherwise ask again forever.
rules.name: answer-printed

rules._note: The monitor prompt. $E000 is where Applesoft starts.
rules.name: enter-applesoft
